};

  int N;
  vector<Edge> E;

  vector<int> d, pt;
  
  Dinic(int N): N(N), E(0), g(N), d(N), pt(N) {}

    if (u != v) {
      E.emplace_back(Edge(u, v, cap));
      g[u].emplace_back(E.size() - 1);
      E.emplace_back(Edge(v, u, 0));
      g[v].emplace_back(E.size() - 1);
    }
  }

  bool BFS(int S, int T) {
    queue<int> q({S});
    fill(d.begin(), d.end(), N + 1);
    d[S] = 0;
    while(!q.empty()) {
      int u = q.front(); q.pop();
      if (u == T) break;
      for (int k: g[u]) {
        Edge &e = E[k];
        if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
          d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
          q.emplace(e.v);

      Edge &oe = E[g[u][i]^1];
      if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
        LL amt = e.cap - e.flow;
        if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
        if (LL pushed = DFS(e.v, T, amt)) {
          e.flow += pushed;
          oe.flow -= pushed;
          return pushed;
        }
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

    LL total = 0;
    while (BFS(S, T)) {
